title: Montserrat Private Tour with Tour Travel & More
text: We had an absolutely wonderful day exploring Montserrat.  I only wish we had had more time to walk some of the trails.  Our guide, Angels, was excellent.  She was so friendly and extremely knowledgeable.  She met us at our hotel and walked us back to our hotel after the tour to make sure we did not lose our way.  I would highly recommend this tour.

title: A fantastic tour to Montserrat
text:
We had an amazing trip to Montserrat from Barcelona. Our guide Julio was very informative and provided lots of information to us about the Monastery.  Julio gave us the option of what we wanted to do at Montserrat, so we took the opportunity to go up in the funicular and see the beautiful sites from the highest point.
We were picked up at the port on the day of disembarkation, our driver and guide were punctual and very friendly.  We were very happy to have found this tour with Tour Travel and More, it was an amazing experience for the four of us.
author: janetcI3317AQ

title: Don’t miss Monserrat
text: The awesome natural setting alone was worth the trip, but the donated art collection is not to be missed. Our guide Angela’s, love of the history and culture of the area was contagious.
author: Marjorie_B

title: Great tour near Barcelona
text:

There are different ways to get to Montserrat , but this tour is by far the most confortable, fast and best prepared to get the most out of the experience.

author: Maura S

title: Great experience
text:
They set up the tour in less than 12 hours and adapted to my needs. Mountains, monastery and spirituality accompanied me at all times. Very emotional visit. My guide, Angels, is a woman with a lot of knowledge of the place (she seems to live there) and knows how to transmit it in a simple way: geology, history, Benedictine norms and even the day to day of the monastery. Despite having agreed 4 hours seeing that there were still things to visit my guide adapted to finish quietly. 
All safety standards recommended by the Ministry of Health regarding Covid-19 are respected. 
Fully recommended to
